description: PickFu runs polls and surveys with real, targeted consumer panels so you can test decisions before you commit. Ask a question — compare two product images, headlines, logos, app icons, or names — and get ranked results with written explanations from real people in the demographic you choose, usually within minutes. Build a poll, launch it to a targeted audience, and read the results (the winner, the vote breakdown, and respondents' comments) without leaving the chat. Built for marketers, founders, designers, and product teams who want evidence instead of guesses.
